name: National Guidelines (US DGA 2020–2025)
description: General healthy-adult limits from the Dietary Guidelines for Americans.

rules.title: Daily sodium limit
rules.evidence: Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020–2025: sodium <2,300 mg/day; saturated fat <10% and added sugars <10% of energy.

rules.title: Added sugar share of energy
rules.evidence: Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020–2025: sodium <2,300 mg/day; saturated fat <10% and added sugars <10% of energy.

rules.title: Saturated fat share of energy
rules.evidence: Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020–2025: sodium <2,300 mg/day; saturated fat <10% and added sugars <10% of energy.

rules.title: Fruit servings
rules.evidence: DGA: about 2 cup-equivalents of fruit at 2,000 kcal.

rules.title: Vegetable servings
rules.evidence: DGA: about 2.5 cup-equivalents of vegetables at 2,000 kcal.
